headline: Bournemouth lead Leicester 3-0 at half-time after Cook, Evanilson and Christie strikes
paragraphs: Bournemouth lead 3-0 at the Vitality Stadium at half-time. Evanilson opened the scoring in the 22nd minute (xG 0.351), assisted by Lewis Cook. Cook doubled the lead in the 26th (xG 0.186) from a Tyler Adams assist, and Ryan Christie made it 3-0 in the 45th (xG 0.574), again set up by Adams. Adam Smith was booked for Bournemouth in the 38th.

Bournemouth's xG of 1.76 against Leicester's 0.81 reflects the quality of their chances, though the shot count was close at 6 to 5, with both sides landing 3 on target. Possession was 52% Bournemouth to 48% Leicester, field tilt 54 to 46 and control 60 to 57, with pass accuracy almost level at 77% to 78%. Leicester's three big chances came from Jordan Ayew (13th, xG 0.251) and Jamie Vardy (28th, xG 0.269), while Tyler Adams had one for Bournemouth (34th, xG 0.311). Momentum swung toward Leicester in the 19th and 44th minutes, but neither spell converted into a shot that changed the score. Chaos index sits at 35 with a tempo of 3.9 passes per minute.

Data caution: the standout log lists Vardy with 1 goal and an xG of 2.19, which conflicts with the goal log (no Leicester goals, score 3-0) and exceeds Leicester's team xG of 0.81. Treat Vardy's figures as unverified until the feed is corrected. Standouts otherwise: Cook 1 goal, 1 assist, xG 0.47, 6 duels won; Adams 2 assists, xG 0.82, pass accuracy 81; Evanilson 1 goal, xG 0.61, pass accuracy 90, 7 duels won.
